mod.touhou_maid_affection.name: Touhou Maid: Affection
mod.touhou_maid_affection.description: Kiss your maid! Adds affectionate interactions to Touhou Little Maid.
tips.touhou_maid_affection.kiss: Sneak + empty hand right-click maid to kiss
tips.touhou_maid_affection.kiss_carried: When carrying a maid with a saddle, press the kiss key to kiss
tips.touhou_maid_affection.kiss_carryon: CarryOn detected: Sneak + empty main hand + item in offhand right-click maid to kiss
tips.touhou_maid_affection.offhand_tempt: Holding temptation items (default: cake) in offhand also attracts maids
bond.title: Bond System
bond.tab.title: Bond Abilities
bond.tab.desc: Unlock deeper interactions as your bond with the maid grows.
bond.morning_kiss.failed_distance: The maid is too far away to call.
bond.random_gift.desc.auto: After unlocking, the maid prepares one gift every so often in real time. Gifts are queued while away, up to 7.
bond.ability.lap.desc: Press B to rest by your maid and enjoy a warm embrace.
bond.ability.heal.desc: Auto-triggers at low HP and stacks with multiple maids.
bond.ability.kiss.desc: The maid paths to you and gives a morning kiss.
bond.ability.ysm.desc: Requires YSM mod to use custom maid animations.
bond.ability.gift.desc: Automatically prepares gifts over time and throws them to you when nearby.
bond.ysm.unavailable: YSM mod is not loaded, fallback effects are enabled
gui.touhou_little_maid.button.bond.desc: -§a View and manage the current maid's bond abilities
effect.touhou_maid_affection.maids_praye: The resonance of affection becomes a devout prayer, infusing your body with vitality. Grants regeneration.
effect.touhou_maid_affection.golden_drea: Resting on your maid's lap purifies negative effects and slowly restores health.
